source.quote: Liverpool and their deal with Standard Chartered that started out in 2010. However, this season is the last in which the financial company is visible on Liverpool’s shirt fronts.

source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 Premier League sponsors
source.quote: Liverpool’s Expedia sleeve deal is reportedly worth less, with £9 million annually

source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 Premier League sponsors
source.note: Kit maker, not a shirt sponsor in the front/back/sleeve sense
source.quote: By sponsoring Arsenal, Manchester United, Aston Villa and Liverpool, Adidas sponsors four of last year’s top five and thus 80 percent of this season’s English Champions League participants.

summary: Standard Chartered on the front in the last season of its deal (Turkish Airlines takes over in 2027/28), Expedia on the sleeve; adidas makes the kit.
